text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An account of the night—a blustering
wind blows, while the snow twirls like a
dancer! Here I stand,
gallant and
graceful...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the face of a door that refuses to
open!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! It appears the frost has
sealed it
shut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That can't be... Wh-what should
we do,
Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, there's no need to panic. Let
us simply
continue with our opera lesson.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do as such, and my fiery passion should
melt the
ice away. Let us resume where
we were!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know that I will fight you, if you can't
teach me
to fear!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Victory goes to me! And so, you are of
my
possession! My fires shall melt your
ice, Turandot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That was wonderful, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The love I desired for so long burns with
joy! A joy
so strong that I must cry out to
the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: La la laaa... ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isolde... You belong to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Doto, it's your line!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?! Uh, uh, all right!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Tr-Tristan... You belong to me!

text_block_list.name: Doto & Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hark! There lies no greater happiness
than that of
love!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slide...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you two okay? It was getting so late,
and I
had no clue where you were...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, but I suppose there was nothing
to worry
about. The both of you kept
yourselves well
entertained. ♪
